label: ABS warning light on
description: Check ABS fuse and harness connector pins for corrosion or bent terminals.
text: ABS warning light on. Check ABS fuse and harness connector pins for corrosion or bent terminals. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: ABS light stays on
description: Inspect wheel hub area for broken sensor cable or magnetic ring debris.
text: ABS light stays on. Inspect wheel hub area for broken sensor cable or magnetic ring debris. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Hard brake pedal
description: Test vacuum hose between intake manifold and booster for cracks or air leaks.
text: Hard brake pedal. Test vacuum hose between intake manifold and booster for cracks or air leaks. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Brake pulling to one side
description: Inspect caliper for brake fluid weeping around piston seal or seized guide slide pins.
text: Brake pulling to one side. Inspect caliper for brake fluid weeping around piston seal or seized guide slide pins. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Brake fluid leak
description: Visually inspect rubber hoses for cracks, bulges (aneurysms) while an assistant presses the pedal.
text: Brake fluid leak. Visually inspect rubber hoses for cracks, bulges (aneurysms) while an assistant presses the pedal. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Spongy brake pedal
description: Check reservoir fluid level and inspect rear of master cylinder where it bolts to booster.
text: Spongy brake pedal. Check reservoir fluid level and inspect rear of master cylinder where it bolts to booster. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Squealing brakes
description: Check friction material thickness through wheel rim opening (minimum legal 2mm - 3mm).
text: Squealing brakes. Check friction material thickness through wheel rim opening (minimum legal 2mm - 3mm). Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Brake pedal pulsation
description: Run fingernail across rotor surface to detect ridges, or measure thickness variation with micrometer.
text: Brake pedal pulsation. Run fingernail across rotor surface to detect ridges, or measure thickness variation with micrometer. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: Spongy brake pedal
description: Remove rear drum to inspect shoe friction lining and wheel cylinder dust boots for fluid seepage.
text: Spongy brake pedal. Remove rear drum to inspect shoe friction lining and wheel cylinder dust boots for fluid seepage. Catégorie : ABS & Braking System.

label: No cold air from vents
description: Observe compressor clutch hub with AC switched ON to see if magnetic clutch engages and spins.
text: No cold air from vents. Observe compressor clutch hub with AC switched ON to see if magnetic clutch engages and spins. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: Warm air from AC vents
description: Inspect aluminum condenser behind front grille for bent cooling fins, leaf blockages, or stone punctures.
text: Warm air from AC vents. Inspect aluminum condenser behind front grille for bent cooling fins, leaf blockages, or stone punctures. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: Musty odor from vents
description: Inspect evaporator drain tube under car for water discharge and check cabin filter.
text: Musty odor from vents. Inspect evaporator drain tube under car for water discharge and check cabin filter. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: Warm air from vents
description: Connect manifold pressure gauges to low and high side service ports to verify gas quantity.
text: Warm air from vents. Connect manifold pressure gauges to low and high side service ports to verify gas quantity. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: Musty odor from vents
description: Remove glove box access hatch and pull out filter pleats to check for dead leaves and black dust.
text: Musty odor from vents. Remove glove box access hatch and pull out filter pleats to check for dead leaves and black dust. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: No air from vents
description: Listen to blower fan under passenger glove compartment across all speeds 1 to 4.
text: No air from vents. Listen to blower fan under passenger glove compartment across all speeds 1 to 4. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: HVAC fan only works on highest setting (Speed 4)
description: Test continuity across resistor pack terminals and inspect thermal fuse.
text: HVAC fan only works on highest setting (Speed 4). Test continuity across resistor pack terminals and inspect thermal fuse. Catégorie : Air Conditioning & Climate.

label: Engine overheating
description: Visually check translucent expansion tank level and inspect for cracks or cap seal degradation.
text: Engine overheating. Visually check translucent expansion tank level and inspect for cracks or cap seal degradation. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Visible coolant puddle under vehicle
description: Pressure test cooling system to 15 PSI (1 bar) with hand pump and inspect for drips.
text: Visible coolant puddle under vehicle. Pressure test cooling system to 15 PSI (1 bar) with hand pump and inspect for drips. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Engine overheating
description: Feel upper and lower radiator hoses while engine warms up to check if thermostat valve opens.
text: Engine overheating. Feel upper and lower radiator hoses while engine warms up to check if thermostat valve opens. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: No heat from cabin vents
description: Touch both heater inlet and outlet hoses at firewall; both should be equally hot when engine is at operating temperature.
text: No heat from cabin vents. Touch both heater inlet and outlet hoses at firewall; both should be equally hot when engine is at operating temperature. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Engine overheating in traffic / at idle
description: Switch AC ON to verify if radiator fan turns on automatically, and test fan relay.
text: Engine overheating in traffic / at idle. Switch AC ON to verify if radiator fan turns on automatically, and test fan relay. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Coolant leak under vehicle
description: Squeeze upper and lower radiator hoses cold; check for spongy texture, hard brittle spots, or clamp cuts.
text: Coolant leak under vehicle. Squeeze upper and lower radiator hoses cold; check for spongy texture, hard brittle spots, or clamp cuts. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Engine overheating
description: Inspect water pump shaft weep hole for coolant drips and check pulley for bearing wobble/play.
text: Engine overheating. Inspect water pump shaft weep hole for coolant drips and check pulley for bearing wobble/play. Catégorie : Engine Cooling System.

label: Engine misfires
description: Use a mechanic stethoscope to listen for regular rhythmic clicking on each injector body.
text: Engine misfires. Use a mechanic stethoscope to listen for regular rhythmic clicking on each injector body. Catégorie : Fuel & Injection System.

label: Engine stalls
description: Pull vacuum hose off fuel pressure regulator; if raw gasoline drips out, internal diaphragm is torn.
text: Engine stalls. Pull vacuum hose off fuel pressure regulator; if raw gasoline drips out, internal diaphragm is torn. Catégorie : Fuel & Injection System.

label: Engine sputters at high speeds
description: Listen for 2-second hum from under rear seat when turning ignition to ON (pos II), and test fuel pressure.
text: Engine sputters at high speeds. Listen for 2-second hum from under rear seat when turning ignition to ON (pos II), and test fuel pressure. Catégorie : Fuel & Injection System.

label: Fuel odor inside vehicle
description: Inspect plastic/metal fuel tank, filler pipe neck for rust holes, and check gas cap rubber seal gasket.
text: Fuel odor inside vehicle. Inspect plastic/metal fuel tank, filler pipe neck for rust holes, and check gas cap rubber seal gasket. Catégorie : Fuel & Injection System.

label: Engine stalls at high speeds
description: Check maintenance history (replace every 40,000 to 60,000 km) and test fuel flow resistance.
text: Engine stalls at high speeds. Check maintenance history (replace every 40,000 to 60,000 km) and test fuel flow resistance. Catégorie : Fuel & Injection System.

label: Engine misfires
description: Pull back top plastic timing cover inspection window to inspect belt teeth, tension, and fraying.
text: Engine misfires. Pull back top plastic timing cover inspection window to inspect belt teeth, tension, and fraying. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Squealing noise from engine bay
description: Inspect ribbed belt surface for micro-cracks, glazing, fraying cords, and check automatic tensioner mark.
text: Squealing noise from engine bay. Inspect ribbed belt surface for micro-cracks, glazing, fraying cords, and check automatic tensioner mark. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Loss of engine power
description: Inspect intercooler rubber boost hoses for splits and check wastegate actuator vacuum movement.
text: Loss of engine power. Inspect intercooler rubber boost hoses for splits and check wastegate actuator vacuum movement. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Hard starting in cold weather
description: Measure electrical resistance of each glow plug with multimeter (normal: 0.5 to 1.5 ohms).
text: Hard starting in cold weather. Measure electrical resistance of each glow plug with multimeter (normal: 0.5 to 1.5 ohms). Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Excessive engine movement / rocking
description: Inspect hydraulic / rubber mounts for tears, hydraulic oil leaks, or excessive engine rock when revving.
text: Excessive engine movement / rocking. Inspect hydraulic / rubber mounts for tears, hydraulic oil leaks, or excessive engine rock when revving. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Oil leak around valve cover
description: Inspect seam between cylinder head and valve cover for wet oil seepage dripping onto hot exhaust manifold.
text: Oil leak around valve cover. Inspect seam between cylinder head and valve cover for wet oil seepage dripping onto hot exhaust manifold. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Low oil pressure warning light on
description: Screw mechanical oil pressure gauge into pressure switch port to measure actual bar/PSI at idle and 3000 RPM.
text: Low oil pressure warning light on. Screw mechanical oil pressure gauge into pressure switch port to measure actual bar/PSI at idle and 3000 RPM. Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Blue smoke from exhaust under acceleration
description: Perform dry and wet cylinder compression test across all cylinders (spec: 11-14 bar for petrol, 25-30 bar for diesel).
text: Blue smoke from exhaust under acceleration. Perform dry and wet cylinder compression test across all cylinders (spec: 11-14 bar for petrol, 25-30 bar for diesel). Catégorie : Engine Mechanical & Valvetrain.

label: Rotten egg / sulfur smell from exhaust
description: Measure inlet and outlet temperature using an infrared thermometer (outlet should be 20°C - 50°C hotter than inlet when functioning).
text: Rotten egg / sulfur smell from exhaust. Measure inlet and outlet temperature using an infrared thermometer (outlet should be 20°C - 50°C hotter than inlet when functioning). Catégorie : Emissions & Exhaust System.

label: Check engine light on (P0130 - P0167)
description: Read live O2 sensor voltage (0.1V to 0.9V switching response) and check internal heater circuit resistance.
text: Check engine light on (P0130 - P0167). Read live O2 sensor voltage (0.1V to 0.9V switching response) and check internal heater circuit resistance. Catégorie : Emissions & Exhaust System.

label: Check engine light on (P0441 / P0444)
description: Unplug vacuum hose and blow through valve; with no 12V power applied, valve must be closed and airtight.
text: Check engine light on (P0441 / P0444). Unplug vacuum hose and blow through valve; with no 12V power applied, valve must be closed and airtight. Catégorie : Emissions & Exhaust System.

label: Loud ticking or puffing exhaust noise on cold start
description: Inspect cylinder head exhaust flange with mirror for black soot streaks and check for broken manifold studs.
text: Loud ticking or puffing exhaust noise on cold start. Inspect cylinder head exhaust flange with mirror for black soot streaks and check for broken manifold studs. Catégorie : Emissions & Exhaust System.

label: Check engine light on (P0105 - P0109)
description: Read live MAP voltage with ignition ON engine OFF (should read ~4.8V / 100 kPa ambient) and check vacuum hose.
text: Check engine light on (P0105 - P0109). Read live MAP voltage with ignition ON engine OFF (should read ~4.8V / 100 kPa ambient) and check vacuum hose. Catégorie : Emissions & Exhaust System.

label: Engine cranks slowly
description: Test resting battery voltage with multimeter (12.6V = 100%, 12.0V = discharged) and check for white/blue terminal corrosion.
text: Engine cranks slowly. Test resting battery voltage with multimeter (12.6V = 100%, 12.0V = discharged) and check for white/blue terminal corrosion. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Battery warning light on while driving
description: Measure voltage across battery terminals while engine idles with headlights and heater blower turned ON (should read 13.8V to 14.5V).
text: Battery warning light on while driving. Measure voltage across battery terminals while engine idles with headlights and heater blower turned ON (should read 13.8V to 14.5V). Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Engine does not crank
description: Check for 12V signal on small ignition wire at starter solenoid while turning key to START.
text: Engine does not crank. Check for 12V signal on small ignition wire at starter solenoid while turning key to START. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Engine misfires under load
description: Mist ignition wires with a water spray bottle in darkness while engine idles; look for blue sparks jumping to ground.
text: Engine misfires under load. Mist ignition wires with a water spray bottle in darkness while engine idles; look for blue sparks jumping to ground. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Window does not move
description: Listen at door panel while pressing switch for motor hum, and test power at motor connector.
text: Window does not move. Listen at door panel while pressing switch for motor hum, and test power at motor connector. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Headlight not working on one side
description: Inspect bulb halogen filament for breakage and check plastic socket connector for heat melting.
text: Headlight not working on one side. Inspect bulb halogen filament for breakage and check plastic socket connector for heat melting. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Wipers not working at all
description: Check wiper fuse, listen for motor hum under cowl, and check if linkage ball joints have popped off.
text: Wipers not working at all. Check wiper fuse, listen for motor hum under cowl, and check if linkage ball joints have popped off. Catégorie : Electrical & Starting System.

label: Clutch pedal feels spongy or stays on floor
description: Check brake/clutch shared fluid reservoir level and inspect carpet above clutch pedal for damp oily residue.
text: Clutch pedal feels spongy or stays on floor. Check brake/clutch shared fluid reservoir level and inspect carpet above clutch pedal for damp oily residue. Catégorie : Transmission & Drivetrain.

label: Transmission slipping (engine revs but car doesn't accelerate)
description: Check ATF fluid level and color on dipstick (or overflow plug at 40°C): should be clear red, not black or smelling burned.
text: Transmission slipping (engine revs but car doesn't accelerate). Check ATF fluid level and color on dipstick (or overflow plug at 40°C): should be clear red, not black or smelling burned. Catégorie : Transmission & Drivetrain.

label: Driveline vibration through floorboard at 80-110 km/h
description: Grab driveshaft / CV axle by hand and twist firmly to check for rotational free play in U-joint caps or torn rubber boots.
text: Driveline vibration through floorboard at 80-110 km/h. Grab driveshaft / CV axle by hand and twist firmly to check for rotational free play in U-joint caps or torn rubber boots. Catégorie : Transmission & Drivetrain.

label: Whining noise from rear end under acceleration
description: Check differential gear oil level and inspect magnetic drain plug for metal shards or low fluid.
text: Whining noise from rear end under acceleration. Check differential gear oil level and inspect magnetic drain plug for metal shards or low fluid. Catégorie : Transmission & Drivetrain.

label: Whining / groaning noise when turning steering wheel
description: Check power steering reservoir fluid dipstick level and check for bubbles / foaming while engine runs.
text: Whining / groaning noise when turning steering wheel. Check power steering reservoir fluid dipstick level and check for bubbles / foaming while engine runs. Catégorie : Steering System.

label: Grinding / roaring humming noise that gets louder with speed
description: Jack up wheel and grasp tire at 12 o'clock and 6 o'clock positions, rock firmly back and forth to detect bearing play.
text: Grinding / roaring humming noise that gets louder with speed. Jack up wheel and grasp tire at 12 o'clock and 6 o'clock positions, rock firmly back and forth to detect bearing play. Catégorie : Wheels & Tires.

label: TPMS warning light on dashboard
description: Check cold tire pressure on all 4 tires (and spare) with gauge against door jamb sticker spec (e.g., 2.3 bar / 33 PSI).
text: TPMS warning light on dashboard. Check cold tire pressure on all 4 tires (and spare) with gauge against door jamb sticker spec (e.g., 2.3 bar / 33 PSI). Catégorie : Wheels & Tires.
